title: Communication Efficient Distributed Newton Method with Fast Convergence Rates

problem.claim: Distributed optimization requires communication- and computation-efficient second-order methods.

contributions.claim: The paper proposes a communication- and computation-efficient second-order method for distributed optimization.

The method is theoretically analyzed and is reported to have a convergence rate similar to classical second-order optimization algorithms, including the stated nonconvex iteration bound and local superlinear convergence under strong convexity.
Experiments on convex and nonconvex problems compare the method with baselines.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The method requires O(d) communication per iteration, where d is the problem dimension.
The method can find the stated second-order stationary points for nonconvex problems within the stated iteration bound.
Experiments show significantly better performance than baselines on convex and nonconvex problems.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper proposes a communication- and computation-efficient second-order method for distributed optimization.
The method is reported to have convergence properties comparable to classical second-order methods, a stated nonconvex iteration bound, and local superlinear convergence under strong convexity.
Experiments on convex and nonconvex problems report better performance than baselines.
